headline: See your website before you pay for it
subheadline: We build a one-page website for your business using the information you already publish. You see it working first and pay only if you want to take it live.

services_lead: A clear price, your own domain and everything your customers need on one page.

services.name: One-page website
services.desc: The full page: your photos, logo and text, mobile-first and secure (https), booking or WhatsApp button, map and opening hours, your own domain with the first year included, and two rounds of changes before launch.

services.name: Care plan
services.desc: Optional from the second year. Hosting, .com renewal, backups and up to 6 change requests a year, completed within 2 working days. Cancel any time.

about: MNKY KONNEKT is a small web studio registered in Spain. We build websites for local businesses in Singapore.
Miguel Ángel López is the founder. He will be the person you speak to, from the first message to launch.

why.title: We build the first version
why.desc: We use the information you already publish and send you a link to the working page.

why.title: You tell us what to change
why.desc: Send your photos, logo and corrections by WhatsApp or email. Two rounds of changes are included.

why.title: You approve, pay and go live
why.desc: When you are happy with the final version, you pay S$590. We put it live on your domain within 7 working days.

faq.a: After you approve the final version, MNKY KONNEKT SL sends you an invoice with a PayNow QR and our SGD bank details. Card is available on request. No GST is charged by us; GST-registered customers should check whether reverse charge applies.
Yes. The domain is registered in your name and the page files are yours. If you stop the care plan, we hand everything over.

faq.q: What if I need more than one page?
faq.a: Most small businesses need exactly one good page. If you need more, a menu, a price list or a gallery, we quote it as a small add-on.

faq.q: How did you get my details?
faq.a: From your website or another public business listing. We use the information you publish to build the first version. Reply "remove" and we delete your details and the draft the same day.
MNKY KONNEKT is registered in Spain and works with businesses in Singapore. You can reach us by WhatsApp or email, and ask for a video call before you decide.
